subject: maths
question:
The below bar graph shows the Foreign trade by countries for the years 2015 - 2016. What was the ratio of minimum trade and maximum trade?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0fa4f102090550d60242692f3456fdcee8e9d0c2a6720c2f7f6415a80ce261d.png]
solution:
**Given:**

The trade of A = 98 million

The trade of J = 1078 million

**Calculation:**

The ratio of minimum trade and maximum trade = 98 : 1078 = 1 : 11

**∴ The required result will be 1: 11.**
